# Contributing to OpenArtemis

Contributions of code, docs, translations, and issue reports are welcome.

## Build from source

Requirements: Go 1.26+, Node.js 20+, PostgreSQL, Python 3 (report rendering, needs
`python-docx`).

```bash
# 1. Frontend static export -> embed
cd web && npm ci && npm run build:static && cd ..
rm -rf server/webui/dist && mkdir -p server/webui/dist && cp -r web/out/. server/webui/dist/

# 2. Built-in skills -> embed (report-generation excluded, it is generated by Go)
rm -rf server/skillsdist && mkdir -p server/skillsdist && cp -r skills/. server/skillsdist/ && rm -rf server/skillsdist/report-generation

# 3. Build the single binary (frontend + skills embedded)
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags embedui -o artemis ./cmd/artemis

# 4. Run (database via env var; use a persistent data dir)
export ARTEMIS_PG_DSN="postgres://artemis:artemis@localhost:5432/artemis?sslmode=disable"
./artemis -addr :8787 -data ~/artemis-data
```

Open http://localhost:8787 ; on first run go to `/setup` to set the admin password.

The database schema is created/migrated idempotently on each start: edit `db/schema.sql`
and restart.

### Containerized rebuild (no host Go/Node)

To rebuild the local image and restart the Compose service without installing Go/Node on
the host, run `scripts/build-image.sh`. It wraps `Dockerfile.build` (frontend static
export + skills staging + `-tags embedui` Go build, all inside containers), exports the
binary to `dist/amd64/artemis`, builds the runtime image, and runs
`docker compose up -d artemis`.

## Conventions

- After frontend changes, re-run the build steps above (static export -> embed -> rebuild
  binary).
- After i18n changes, run `node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs` to reconcile the locale keys.
- Keep the compile green: `go build ./...`.
- Keep commit messages concise and explain the motivation.

## Workflow

1. Fork the repo and branch off `main`.
2. Make your change, keep the build green.
3. Open a Pull Request describing the motivation and scope.

## Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By
participating you are expected to uphold it. Report unacceptable behavior to
francesco@oghabi.it.

To report a security vulnerability in OpenArtemis itself, see
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) (do not open a public issue).
